idea-plugin.name: Riso Themes
idea-plugin.description:
Themes printed like a risograph: an ink on paper, a second ink, and nothing more.

Eleven inks — Touge, Pink, Orange, Sunflower, Mustard, Green, Teal, Blue, Federal Blue, Purple, Grey — and the Pink × Blue duotone, each on three papers: near black, Dimmed and Paper (light). Every text color is checked for contrast on every paper.

  • Rainbow brackets: one color per nesting level, in any language.
  • Color by name (Python): every parameter, local, attribute, constant and class gets its own color, derived from its name — the same color as in the Riso VS Code extension.

Both work under any theme and can be turned off in Settings → Appearance → Riso. The same palettes as the VS Code extension, generated from one source.
